traits.name: Assume Form
traits.text: (concentrate, occult, polymorph, transmutation); The faceless stalker spends 10 minutes reshaping its appearance to take on the shape of any Small or Medium humanoid. It gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to pass as that creature.

traits.name: Blood Nourishment
traits.text: ⬻ The faceless stalker uses its three-pronged tongue to drink the blood of an adjacent restrained or unconscious creature. The creature gains drained 1.

traits.name: Compression
traits.text: When the faceless stalker successfully Squeezes, it moves through the tight space at full speed. Narrow confines are not difficult terrain for a faceless stalker.

traits.name: Revert Form
traits.text: ⭓ Requirements The faceless stalker is in an assumed form. Effect The faceless stalker resumes its true form. Until the start of its next turn, it gains a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The faceless stalker deals 1d6 (1d6) extra precision damage to flat-footed creatures.
